output.explanation: Expanded workspace because its registry, sessions and mounted renderers hide substantial owned composition. The central diagram now separates page-owned coordination from session ownership and borrowed rendering resources. Two peripherals deepen CanvasWorkspace lifetimes and mounted document surfaces, with direct links for their shared session/controller interactions. Domain and backend remain unchanged as semantic and collaborator context. Checked the pinned checkout's App/services, MappingPage, workspace/session/persistence classes, renderer runtimes, history service and backend bootstrap. Corrected SourceWindowPanel to an editor sibling, moved selection/local-chat API calls from AgentChatPanel to MappingPocSelectionCanvas, and clarified that session commit notifications follow checkpoint-ID changes rather than only newly created checkpoints. All original edges are retained, with moved endpoints updated. Existing domain/backend positions shift only to accommodate the peripherals; the checkout is unchanged.

|           |-- Saved baseline + cached scene/edge hashes
|           |   `-- updateBaseline(captured save) -> dirty status
|           |-- Read-only store facades over private Zustand stores
|           |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument

|           |   `-- status: sceneDirty / isDirty / canUndo / canRedo

|           |   |-- Snapshot + editing-context handle + optional editor driver
|           |   |-- Commands -> validate / reconcile / shared history service
|           |   `-- subscribe() -> session publishes changed store slices
|           |-- Commit listeners
|           |   `-- Changed canvasRevisionId -> onCommit -> workspace.onPersist
|           `-- dispose(): clear cursor copy, unsubscribe, clear listeners
|-- Controller index: document ID -> session.controller (borrowed reference)
|-- Subscription registry: per-session commit / status / document listeners
|   |-- Commits -> changes version + persistence listeners
|   |-- Status -> dirty-scene index
|   `-- Document changes -> refresh draft entry for explorer/search
|-- Read-only changes and dirtyScenes stores
|-- Persistence listener set: onPersist(ids) -> external adapter
|-- Injected CanvasHistoryService reference (not owned per workspace)
|   `-- Passed to each session/controller -> isolated editing contexts

    |   `-- setDrafts() -> new draft/session sharing immutable revisions
    `-- dispose(): unsubscribe registry, clear listeners, dispose sessions
